invite.title: Mansur
invite.text: A man with rings on every finger leans close. “A traveller with a heavy purse should not sit alone at night. Behind the inn, the door with the blue cloth. Dice, friends, and luck.”

house.title: The dice house
house.text: Lamps, smoke and the click of dice. Mansur keeps the board. Nobody looks at faces here.
house.won: The dice fall your way. You win {n} coins.
house.lost: The dice fall against you. You lose {n} coins.

talk: There's talk about the back lanes
